name: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor equipment precision parts and components in China and internationally. It provides process and structural components, module products, and gas transmission systems that are used in semiconductor equipment, such as etching, thin film deposition, photolithography and glue coating development, chemical mechanical polishing, ion implantation and other fields. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Shenyang, China.
